This fixes a problem spotted with zebra
column2: but not sure if it is

column1: necessary a kernel problem.  With IPV6 when an address is added to an

column2: Zebra creates a duplicate RIB entry
and other as a kernel route.

column1: When an address is added to an interface the RTN_NEWADDR message
causes Zebra to create a connected route. In IPV4 when an address is
added to an interface a RTN_NEWROUTE message is set to user space with
the protocol RTPROT_KERNEL. Zebra ignores these messages
The problem is that route created in IPV6 has route protocol ==
RTPROT_BOOT.  Was this a design decision or a bug? This fixes it. Same
patch applies to both net-2.6 and stable.
